details: Built a queue-based event platform on AWS for reliable, priority-based background processing.
Worked on event auditing, retries, failure recovery, and systems handling 15K+ events every week.
Built backend services and a serverless BFF serving 20K+ weekly users across 25+ APIs.
Worked on caching, authentication, package visibility, CSV workflows, and large-file uploads.
Built a distributed file-processing system using FastAPI, Celery, SQS, and S3.
Improved processing throughput 4× through chunk-based parallel execution.
